_说明: 综合研判短句表（需求文档附录 D 定稿）。改措辞只改这里，下一次生成就生效。{} 是运行时填入的数值。方向只由 L2 给；动作只来自 L1 的风险预算规则和 L2 研究的交接原则；L3、L4 负责确认与提醒。

BULL.一句话EN: Cycle in a bull phase, pointing up
BULL.分段: 价格仍在创新高，周期处于牛市阶段，方向向上。
BULL.分段EN: Price is still making new highs; the cycle is in its bull phase and points up.

BULL_RISK.分段: 已经走进历史上最常见的见顶时段（减半后 480~600 天），或估值进入高估区。这里的回放结果接近抛硬币：之后一年中位 −6%，上涨的时候只有 47%。
BULL_RISK.分段EN: We are in the window where past cycles usually peaked (480–600 days after the halving), or valuations have turned expensive. Replays here are close to a coin flip: a median one-year return of −6%, positive only 47% of the time.

BULL_PULLBACK.一句话: 牛市回撤中，方向待确认
BULL_PULLBACK.分段: 价格从高点回撤已超过两成。是牛市里的一次深蹲，还是转熊的开始，还需要时间确认。
BULL_PULLBACK.分段EN: Price is more than 20% off its high. Whether this is a deep squat in a bull market or the start of a bear market still needs time to tell.

BEAR.一句话EN: Cycle in a bear phase, pointing down
BEAR.分段: 周期处于熊市阶段。历史回放里，这个阶段之后一年中位 −36%，上涨的时候只有 31%。
BEAR.分段EN: The cycle is in its bear phase. In historical replays, the following year had a median return of −36%, positive only 31% of the time.

BEAR_ZONE.分段: 底部信号开始陆续亮起（已亮 {n}/6），但还缺最后的确认。历史回放里，这个阶段之后一年中位 +68%，91% 的时间收涨。
BEAR_ZONE.分段EN: Bottom signals are starting to light up ({n}/6), but the final confirmation is still missing. In historical replays, the following year had a median return of +68%, positive 91% of the time.

RECOVERY.一句话: 周期底部已确认，方向偏多
RECOVERY.分段: 底部已经确认，这是本阶段第 {天数} 天。历史回放里，这个阶段之后一年中位 +152%，92% 的时间收涨，但途中出现两到六成的回撤也很常见。失效条件：收盘跌破本轮最低收盘 {价格}。
RECOVERY.分段EN: The bottom is confirmed; this is day {days} of the phase. In historical replays, the following year had a median return of +152%, positive 92% of the time, though 20–60% drawdowns along the way were common. Invalidation: a daily close below this cycle's lowest close, {price}.

_缺.分段: L2 状态机今天没有数据。
_缺.分段EN: The L2 state machine has no data today.

顺风.分段: 市场乐观、信用宽松、实际利率没有急升，宏观在推着走。风险预算照常使用。
顺风.分段EN: Markets are optimistic, credit is easy and real yields are not surging. Macro is pushing; use the risk budget as normal.

中性.分段: 宏观既不推，也不拦。风险预算照常。
中性.分段EN: Macro is neither pushing nor holding back. Risk budget as normal.

中性偏谨慎.分段: 实际利率在一个季度内急升，这本身就是一股独立的逆风。风险预算降一档，不加仓。
中性偏谨慎.分段EN: Real yields have jumped within a quarter, a headwind in its own right. Cut the risk budget one notch; no adding.

逆风.分段: {触发原因}，宏观在拖后腿。风险预算打七折。
逆风.分段EN: {trigger}, so macro is a drag. Size the risk budget at 70%.

警戒.分段: 另外，高收益债利差正在快速走阔；它比其他信用指标跑得快，但还没有长历史检验，先当作一声提醒。
警戒.分段EN: Also, high-yield spreads are widening fast. They move ahead of other credit gauges but lack a long track record, so treat this as an early warning.

_缺.分段: L1 今天缺少关键读数，不给档位。
_缺.分段EN: L1 is missing key readings today; no regime.

逆风原因.条件: 实际利率急升 + BAA 利差 13 周转紧
逆风原因.中文: 实际利率急升，又碰上信用利差走阔
逆风原因.英文: Surging real yields now meet widening credit spreads
逆风原因.条件EN: Real-yield surge + BAA spread tightening over 13w

逆风原因.条件: 实际利率急升 + NFCI 13 周转紧
逆风原因.中文: 实际利率急升，又碰上金融条件转紧
逆风原因.英文: Surging real yields now meet tightening financial conditions

逆风原因.条件: 实际利率急升 + 乐观度 z < 0
逆风原因.中文: 实际利率急升，市场乐观度也跌到了零以下
逆风原因.英文: Real yields are surging and market optimism has slipped below zero

逆风原因.条件: 流动性闸门（净流动性 13 周 ≤ −2.72% 且美元 13 周走强）
逆风原因.中文: 流动性在收缩、美元在走强，流动性闸门打开
逆风原因.英文: Liquidity is shrinking while the dollar strengthens, tripping the liquidity gate
逆风原因.条件EN: Liquidity gate (net liquidity 13w ≤ −2.72% and a stronger dollar over 13w)

逆风: 节奏上不追高，风险预算打七折

顺风: 可它改变不了熊市的深度
but it won't change how deep a bear market goes
中性偏谨慎: cut the risk budget one notch

L3._说明: L3 只描述价格位置和波动幅度，不给方向（《BTC筹码层L3研究》）。{压力区}{STH成本}{距离}{STH13}{波动}{集中度} 运行时填入。

above.分段: 价格已经收盘站上短期持有者成本 +1σ（{压力区}）2% 以上，冲过了上方压力区。冲过去并站上 STH-MVRV 1.3（约 {STH13}）后，历史上多是一段延续（假设，2018 年后 14 次）。
above.分段EN: Price has closed more than 2% above the STH cost +1σ ({zone}) and broken through the pressure zone. Once price holds STH-MVRV 1.3 (about {sth13}), history mostly shows a continuing move (a hypothesis; 14 cases since 2018).

in_zone.分段: 价格正在短期持有者成本 +1σ 的压力区里（{压力区}，上下 2%）。历史上碰到这里后 30 天不被突破的比例是 63%，形状一样的假线只有 42%。
in_zone.分段EN: Price is inside the STH cost +1σ pressure zone ({zone}, ±2%). Historically, after a touch it was not broken within 30 days 63% of the time, versus 42% for same-shaped placebo lines.

between.分段: 价格在短期持有者成本（{STH成本}）和上方压力区（{压力区}，离现价 {距离}）之间。
between.分段EN: Price sits between the STH cost ({sth}) and the pressure zone above ({zone}, {gap} from price).

below.分段: 价格跌到了短期持有者成本（{STH成本}）下方，最近约 5 个月买入的人整体浮亏；这条线 2018 年后作支撑接近随机，只作参考。
below.分段EN: Price has fallen below the STH cost ({sth}); buyers of roughly the last five months are under water. Since 2018 this line has been close to random as support — reference only.

预警.分段: 大波动预警亮（30 天波动 {波动}，筹码集中度 {集中度}）：接下来 30 天大概率走出 15% 左右的单边，方向不定。
预警.分段EN: The large-move warning is on (30-day volatility {vol}, supply concentration {conc}): a one-way move of about 15% within 30 days is more likely than usual, direction unknown.

in_zone: Price is in the supply pressure zone.
both: 价格在筹码压力区，大波动预警亮。
Price is in the supply pressure zone, with a large-move warning on.

L4._说明: L4 依据《BTC情绪衍生品层L4研究》（规格 §5）。只有「信号」一档进动作；其余四档是温度描述。{档杠杆}{档情绪}{关键读数} 运行时填入。

信号.一句话: 资金费率转负，空头拥挤：短期不追空
信号.一句话EN: funding has turned negative — shorts are crowded; don't chase shorts
信号.分段EN: 30-day average funding is {value} (annualized), negative for {days} days: shorts are crowded (validated · direction). Use: no new shorts; when L2 is not in a bear market, scaling in within the L1 budget is allowed. The risk budget does not grow.

过热.一句话EN: short-term leverage and sentiment running hot
过热.分段: 杠杆{档杠杆}、情绪{档情绪}（{关键读数}）。这是一支温度计，不是方向标。
过热.分段EN: Short-term leverage and sentiment running hot ({reading}). A thermometer, not a compass.

偏热.一句话EN: short-term leverage and sentiment running warm
偏热.分段: 杠杆{档杠杆}、情绪{档情绪}（{关键读数}）。这是一支温度计，不是方向标。
偏热.分段EN: Short-term leverage and sentiment running warm ({reading}). A thermometer, not a compass.

中性.分段: 短期温度中性：杠杆{档杠杆}、情绪{档情绪}。只作描述。

偏冷.分段: 杠杆{档杠杆}、情绪{档情绪}（{关键读数}）。这是一支温度计，不是方向标。

信号非熊市: ，允许在 L1 预算内分批加
; scaling in within the L1 budget is allowed

小字: 方向看周期，节奏看宏观；筹码和情绪用来确认和提醒。
The cycle sets the direction, macro sets the pace; flows and sentiment confirm and caution.
